chapter.name: Vishvarupa Darshana Yoga
chapter.englishName: Yoga of the Vision of the Universal Form
chapter.description: Arjuna requests to see Krishna's universal form. Krishna grants divine vision, revealing His cosmic form that encompasses all existence, demonstrating His infinite power, glory, and the unity of creation.
chapter.theme: Revelation of the universal cosmic form of God and realization of divine omnipresence
chapter.yogaType: Vishvarupa Darshana Yoga - Vision of the Cosmic Form

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् | यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | mad-anugrahāya paramaṃ guhyam adhyātma-saṃjñitam | yat tvayoktaṃ vacas tena moho 'yaṃ vigato mama ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: By Your grace, my delusion has been dispelled by Your teachings.
verses.meaning: Arjuna acknowledges the clarity gained from Krishna’s wisdom.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया | त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ||
verses.transliteration: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā | tvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣa māhātmyam api cāvyayam ||
verses.english_translation: I have heard from You about creation and dissolution and Your greatness.
verses.meaning: Arjuna reflects on Krishna’s teachings.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर | द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ||
verses.transliteration: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṃ parameśvara | draṣṭum icchāmi te rūpam aiśvaraṃ puruṣottama ||
verses.english_translation: O Lord, I wish to see Your divine form.
verses.meaning: Arjuna desires a direct vision of God.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो | योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ||
verses.transliteration: manyase yadi tac chakyaṃ mayā draṣṭum iti prabho | yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānam avyayam ||
verses.english_translation: If You think I am able, show me Your eternal form.
verses.meaning: Arjuna humbly requests divine vision.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः | नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ | nānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛtīni ca ||
verses.english_translation: Krishna said: Behold My divine forms in hundreds and thousands of varieties.
verses.meaning: Krishna prepares to reveal His cosmic form.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा | बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ||
verses.transliteration: paśyādityān vasūn rudrān aśvinau marutas tathā | bahūny adṛṣṭa-pūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata ||
verses.english_translation: See the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, and many wonders never seen before.
verses.meaning: The universal form contains all divine beings.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् | मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि ||
verses.transliteration: ihaika-sthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sa-carācaram | mama dehe guḍākeśa yac cānyad draṣṭum icchasi ||
verses.english_translation: See the entire universe in My body.
verses.meaning: Krishna reveals the unity of all existence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा | दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ||
verses.transliteration: na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭum anenaiva sva-cakṣuṣā | divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogam aiśvaram ||
verses.english_translation: You cannot see Me with ordinary eyes; I grant you divine vision.
verses.meaning: Divine perception is required to see the ultimate reality.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: संजय उवाच | एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः | दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् ||
verses.transliteration: sañjaya uvāca | evam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśvaro hariḥ | darśayām āsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpam aiśvaram ||
verses.english_translation: Sanjaya said: Krishna then revealed His supreme form to Arjuna.
verses.meaning: The narration shifts to Sanjaya describing the vision.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् | अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ||
verses.transliteration: aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśanam | aneka-divyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham ||
verses.english_translation: The form had many faces, eyes, and divine ornaments.
verses.meaning: The cosmic form is vast and awe-inspiring.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् | सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ||
verses.transliteration: divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṃ divya-gandhānulepanam | sarvāścarya-mayaṃ devam anantaṃ viśvato-mukham ||
verses.english_translation: It was adorned with divine garlands and had faces everywhere.
verses.meaning: The universal form is infinite and all-encompassing.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता | यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ||
verses.transliteration: divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā | yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: If a thousand suns rose at once, it would resemble His radiance.
verses.meaning: The brilliance of the divine form is beyond imagination.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमननेकधा | अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ||
verses.transliteration: tatraika-sthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktam anekadhā | apaśyad deva-devasya śarīre pāṇḍavas tadā ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna saw the entire universe in Krishna’s body.
verses.meaning: All existence is unified in the divine.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः | प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ||
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ | praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata ||
verses.english_translation: Amazed and filled with wonder, Arjuna bowed and spoke.
verses.meaning: Arjuna is overwhelmed by the divine vision.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान् | ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थमृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान् ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | paśyāmi devāṃs tava deva dehe sarvāṃs tathā bhūta-viśeṣa-saṅghān | brahmāṇam īśaṃ kamalāsana-stham ṛṣīṃś ca sarvān uragāṃś ca divyān ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: I see all gods, beings, Brahma, sages, and divine serpents in Your form.
verses.meaning: Arjuna witnesses all creation within Krishna.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् | नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ||
verses.transliteration: aneka-bāhūdara-vaktra-netraṃ paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato 'nanta-rūpam | nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punas tavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśva-rūpa ||
verses.english_translation: I see Your infinite form everywhere, with no beginning, middle, or end.
verses.meaning: Arjuna realizes the boundless nature of the divine.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् | पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् ||
verses.transliteration: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca tejo-rāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam | paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantād dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam ||
verses.english_translation: I see You radiant like blazing fire and sun, difficult to behold.
verses.meaning: The divine form is overwhelmingly powerful.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् | त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ||
verses.transliteration: tvam akṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvam asya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam | tvam avyayaḥ śāśvata-dharma-goptā sanātanas tvaṃ puruṣo mato me ||
verses.english_translation: You are the eternal, supreme truth and protector of the universe.
verses.meaning: Arjuna recognizes Krishna as the ultimate reality.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्यमनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् | पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ||
verses.transliteration: anādi-madhyāntam ananta-vīryam ananta-bāhuṃ śaśi-sūrya-netram | paśyāmi tvāṃ dīpta-hutāśa-vaktraṃ sva-tejasā viśvam idaṃ tapantam ||
verses.english_translation: You are without beginning, middle, or end, blazing like fire and sun.
verses.meaning: The cosmic form radiates immense power.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः | दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ||
verses.transliteration: dyāv-āpṛthivyor idam antaraṃ hi vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaś ca sarvāḥ | dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpam ugraṃ tavedaṃ loka-trayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman ||
verses.english_translation: You pervade heaven and earth; all worlds tremble at Your form.
verses.meaning: The universal form inspires awe and fear.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्ति केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति | स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ||
verses.transliteration: amī hi tvāṃ sura-saṅghā viśanti kecid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti | svastīty uktvā maharṣi-siddha-saṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Gods enter You; some praise You with folded hands in fear.
verses.meaning: All beings respond to the divine form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च | गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ||
verses.transliteration: rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve 'śvinau marutaś coṣmapāś ca | gandharva-yakṣāsura-siddha-saṅghā vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāś caiva sarve ||
verses.english_translation: All divine beings gaze at You in wonder.
verses.meaning: Even celestial beings are amazed.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् | बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ||
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraṃ mahā-bāho bahu-bāhūru-pādam | bahūdaraṃ bahu-daṃṣṭra-karālaṃ dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing Your many mouths and terrifying teeth, all are disturbed.
verses.meaning: The fierce aspect of the divine is revealed.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनैकवर्णं व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् | दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ||
verses.transliteration: nabhaḥ-spṛśaṃ dīptam aneka-varṇaṃ vyāttānanaṃ dīpta-viśāla-netram | dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntar-ātmā dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo ||
verses.english_translation: Your blazing form touches the sky; I am shaken and cannot remain calm.
verses.meaning: Arjuna feels overwhelmed.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि | दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ||
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrā-karālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānala-sannibhāni | diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagan-nivāsa ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing Your fierce mouths, I lose direction; please be merciful.
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks reassurance.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः | भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ||
verses.transliteration: amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ | bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūta-putras tathāsau sahāsmadīyair api yodha-mukhyaiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: I see all warriors entering Your mouths.
verses.meaning: Arjuna sees destruction of warriors.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि | केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु सन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः ||
verses.transliteration: vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṃṣṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni | kecid vilagnā daśanāntareṣu sandṛśyante cūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Some are crushed between Your teeth.
verses.meaning: The vision shows inevitable destruction.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति | तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति ||
verses.transliteration: yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo 'mbu-vegāḥ samudram evābhimukhā dravanti | tathā tavāmī nara-loka-vīrā viśanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti ||
verses.english_translation: Like rivers flowing to the ocean, warriors rush into Your mouths.
verses.meaning: Destruction is inevitable.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः | तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ||
verses.transliteration: yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddha-vegāḥ | tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokās tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddha-vegāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Like moths rushing into fire, beings rush to destruction.
verses.meaning: Fate leads beings to their end.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः | तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ||
verses.transliteration: lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ | tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṃ bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo ||
verses.english_translation: You devour all worlds with blazing mouths, filling the universe with Your radiance.
verses.meaning: Krishna is seen as time destroying everything.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद | विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ||
verses.transliteration: ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugra-rūpo namo 'stu te deva-vara prasīda | vijñātum icchāmi bhavantam ādyam na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim ||
verses.english_translation: Tell me who You are in this fierce form; I bow to You, please be gracious.
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks to understand the terrifying aspect of Krishna.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः | ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | kālo 'smi loka-kṣaya-kṛt pravṛddho lokān samāhartum iha pravṛttaḥ | ṛte 'pi tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye 'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: I am Time, the destroyer of worlds, engaged in annihilating all people.
verses.meaning: Krishna reveals Himself as time and inevitable destruction.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् | मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ||
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tvam uttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham | mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva nimitta-mātraṃ bhava savya-sācin ||
verses.english_translation: Arise and gain glory; these warriors are already slain by Me—be merely an instrument.
verses.meaning: Humans act as instruments of divine will.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च कर्णं तथान्यानपि योधवीरान् | मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ||
verses.transliteration: droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca karṇaṃ tathānyān api yodha-vīrān | mayā hatāṃs tvaṃ jahi mā vyathiṣṭhā yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān ||
verses.english_translation: Drona, Bhishma, Karna and others are already slain—fight without fear.
verses.meaning: Krishna assures victory aligned with destiny.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: संजय उवाच | एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी | नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ||
verses.transliteration: sañjaya uvāca | etac chrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya kṛtāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī | namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ sa-gadgadaṃ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya ||
verses.english_translation: Sanjaya said: Hearing this, Arjuna trembled and bowed to Krishna.
verses.meaning: Arjuna is deeply shaken by the revelation.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च | रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagat prahṛṣyaty anurajyate ca | rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddha-saṅghāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: O Krishna, the world rejoices in Your glory and demons flee in fear.
verses.meaning: The divine inspires both devotion and fear.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन् गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे | अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ||
verses.transliteration: kasmāc ca te na nameran mahātman garīyase brahmaṇo 'py ādi-kartre | ananta deveśa jagan-nivāsa tvam akṣaraṃ sad-asat tat paraṃ yat ||
verses.english_translation: Why should they not bow to You, the origin of all, beyond existence and non-existence?
verses.meaning: Krishna is beyond all dualities.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् | वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप ||
verses.transliteration: tvam ādi-devaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇas tvam asya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam | vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma tvayā tataṃ viśvam ananta-rūpa ||
verses.english_translation: You are the primal God, the ultimate refuge, and the knower of all.
verses.meaning: Arjuna fully glorifies Krishna.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च | नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते ||
verses.transliteration: vāyur yamo 'gnir varuṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ prajāpatis tvaṃ prapitāmahaś ca | namo namas te 'stu sahasra-kṛtvaḥ punaś ca bhūyo 'pi namo namas te ||
verses.english_translation: You are all gods—air, fire, moon—I bow to You again and again.
verses.meaning: Krishna is all forms of divinity.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व | अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः ||
verses.transliteration: namaḥ purastād atha pṛṣṭhatas te namo 'stu te sarvata eva sarva | ananta-vīryāmita-vikramas tvaṃ sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato 'si sarvaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Salutations to You from all sides; You are everything.
verses.meaning: Krishna is all-pervading.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति | अजानता महिमानं तवेदं मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ||
verses.transliteration: sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yad uktaṃ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti | ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi ||
verses.english_translation: Thinking of You as a friend, I spoke casually without knowing Your greatness.
verses.meaning: Arjuna apologizes for past familiarity.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु | एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम् ||
verses.transliteration: yac cāvahāsārtham asat-kṛto 'si vihāra-śayyāsana-bhojaneṣu | eko 'thavāpy acyuta tat-samakṣaṃ tat kṣāmaye tvām aham aprameyam ||
verses.english_translation: Forgive me for disrespect shown in jest or familiarity.
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks forgiveness.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् | न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव ||
verses.transliteration: pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvam asya pūjyaś ca gurur garīyān | na tvat-samo 'sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto 'nyo loka-traye 'py apratima-prabhāva ||
verses.english_translation: You are the father and guru of the universe; none is equal or greater.
verses.meaning: Krishna is supreme above all.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं प्रसादये त्वामहमīशमीड्यम् | पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्यु: प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् ||
verses.transliteration: tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ prasādaye tvām aham īśam īḍyam | piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum ||
verses.english_translation: Like a father or friend, please forgive me.
verses.meaning: Arjuna surrenders with humility.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे | तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ||
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭa-pūrvaṃ hṛṣito 'smi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me | tad eva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ prasīda deveśa jagan-nivāsa ||
verses.english_translation: I am delighted yet fearful; please show me Your gentle form again.
verses.meaning: Arjuna requests Krishna to return to a familiar form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तमिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव | तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते ||
verses.transliteration: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakra-hastam icchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭum ahaṃ tathaiva | tenaiva rūpeṇa catur-bhujena sahasra-bāho bhava viśva-mūrte ||
verses.english_translation: I wish to see You again in Your four-armed form with crown and mace.
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks the familiar divine form.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् | तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitam ātma-yogāt | tejo-mayaṃ viśvam anantam ādyaṃ yan me tvad-anyena na dṛṣṭa-pūrvam ||
verses.english_translation: By My grace, I have shown you this supreme, radiant universal form.
verses.meaning: The vision is a rare divine blessing.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर् न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः | एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर ||
verses.transliteration: na veda-yajñādhyayanaiḥ na dānair na ca kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ | evaṃ-rūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛ-loke draṣṭuṃ tvad-anyena kuru-pravīra ||
verses.english_translation: This form cannot be seen through rituals, study, or austerities.
verses.meaning: Divine vision is beyond ordinary practices.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् | व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ||
verses.transliteration: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍha-bhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoram īdṛṅ mamedam | vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punas tvaṃ tad eva me rūpam idaṃ prapaśya ||
verses.english_translation: Do not be afraid; behold My gentle form again.
verses.meaning: Krishna reassures Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: संजय उवाच | इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः | आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ||
verses.transliteration: sañjaya uvāca | ity arjunaṃ vāsudevas tathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayām āsa bhūyaḥ | āśvāsayām āsa ca bhītam enaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapur mahātmā ||
verses.english_translation: Krishna resumed His gentle form and comforted Arjuna.
verses.meaning: The cosmic vision ends; calm returns.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन | इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana | idānīm asmi saṃvṛttaḥ sa-cetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing Your gentle human form, I am calm and restored.
verses.meaning: Arjuna regains composure.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम | देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | sudurdarśam idaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavān asi yan mama | devā apy asya rūpasya nityaṃ darśana-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: This form is difficult to behold; even gods long to see it.
verses.meaning: The vision is extremely rare.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया | शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ||
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ vedair na tapasā na dānena na cejyayā | śakya evaṃ-vidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavān asi māṃ yathā ||
verses.english_translation: I cannot be seen in this form by study, austerity, or rituals.
verses.meaning: Divine realization is not through external means.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन | ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ||
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā tv ananyayā śakya aham evaṃ-vidho 'rjuna | jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa ||
verses.english_translation: Only through undivided devotion can I be known and seen.
verses.meaning: Bhakti (devotion) is the true path to God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः | निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ||
verses.transliteration: mat-karma-kṛn mat-paramo mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ | nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava ||
verses.english_translation: One who works for Me, is devoted, free from attachment and hatred, comes to Me.
verses.meaning: Selfless devotion and purity lead to union with God.
